description: One deposit payload as prepareRelay carries it in proofInputs, wincode with a u8 asset tag and a u16 ciphertext length. The ring is 0x06 repeated, the tree 0x2a, the depositor 0x29, the recipient the shielded keypair of Ed25519 seed 0x05 repeated. It deposits 700 of the SPL mint 0x30 from token account 0x31 under token program 0x32, view tag 0x2b, tx viewing key 0x2c, salt 0x2d and ciphertext 0x2e repeated 8 times, blinding secret 0x2f and audit ephemeral secret 0x33. Pinned by the sdk-libs/client rpc tests and the TypeScript encodeRelayDepositInputs test.
